entry.name: rnbo_granulator~
entry.description: Granular sample playback for buffer~ objects.

arguments.name: buffername
arguments.description: The first argument is a name of aobject for granulator to reference for playback.

arguments.name: start
arguments.description: The second argument determines the starting point in samples for playback for the referenced.

arguments.name: length
arguments.description: The third argument determines the speed of playback in samples from the user-specified starting point of granulators' playback.

arguments.name: rate
arguments.description: The fourth argument determines the rate of playback for the user-specified length of granulators playback. A signal increment of 0 stops playback. A signal increment of 1 plays the sample at normal speed. A sample increment of -1 plays the sample backwards at normal speed. A sample increment of 2 plays the sample at twice the normal speed.

arguments.name: bchan
arguments.description: The fifth argument determines which channel of the referenced buffer~ to playback. The base value and default value is 0.
